positions.name: Oracle
positions.catalyst: Q4 FY26 earnings Wed 6/10 AMC. RPO ~$553B (+325% YoY), OCI rev guided +46-50%; cons EPS ~$1.58-1.96. Sold off ~9.6% Fri 6/5 in the AI-capex flush to $213.68 = de-risked into a high-backlog print.
positions.risks: AI-capex/margin scrutiny; capex-vs-revenue bridge is the swing factor; broad AI-infra de-rating could extend.
positions.driver: Largest AI-cloud earnings catalyst of the week, entered after a pullback rather than at the highs.

positions.name: Casey's General Stores
positions.catalyst: FQ4 FY26 earnings Wed 6/10 BMO. Cons EPS ~$3.32 on ~$4.31B rev; estimates revised +7.1% over 90d; +66% TTM, trading near its 52w high.
positions.risks: Near 52w high = elevated bar; fuel-margin volatility; rich multiple for a c-store.
positions.driver: Defensive-growth compounder with steadily rising estimates into a BMO print - fits the rotation out of tech.

positions.name: Newmont
positions.catalyst: Record gold prices put Newmont back in focus early June; gold/materials lead the 2026 rotation. 52w $52-$135 leaves room below the high.
positions.risks: Gold reversal on a hot CPI / stronger dollar; mine-cost inflation; no company-specific catalyst.
positions.driver: Largest gold miner levered to record bullion as real assets lead the market.

positions.name: Agnico Eagle Mines
positions.catalyst: Record Q1 operating margins (FCF $732M); Barclays initiated Overweight; record-gold tailwind. 52w ~$115-$255.
positions.risks: Pulled back ~4.6% Fri 6/5; gold-price sensitivity; CPI-week dollar risk.
positions.driver: Best-operating-margin senior gold miner with a fresh Overweight initiation confirming the move.

positions.name: Lockheed Martin
positions.catalyst: Defense complex bid on Middle East escalation (Hormuz tensions); projected ~$1.5T FY27 US defense budget; LMT near records.
positions.risks: Headline de-escalation risk; program/charge risk; budget timing.
positions.driver: Prime defense beneficiary of the geopolitical risk bid and rising defense outlays.

positions.name: RTX Corporation
positions.catalyst: Jefferies initiated Buy 6/4 with a PT raise; defense re-rating on Middle East escalation; RTX confirming with +3%+ moves.
positions.risks: De-escalation risk; supplier/engine issues; valuation after the run.
positions.driver: Fresh Buy initiation plus the defense bid and strong aerospace-aftermarket demand.

positions.name: Caterpillar
positions.catalyst: Industrials lead the 2026 rotation (+16% YTD) with CAT the largest contributor; near 52w high $946.83 after a Fri 6/5 pullback to $912.
positions.risks: Cyclical/tariff exposure; pulled back ~3.7% Fri; high absolute level.
positions.driver: Bellwether industrial riding the rotation out of mega-cap tech into machinery/infrastructure.

positions.name: GE Aerospace
positions.catalyst: Near 52w high $348; Strong Buy consensus (19 buy / 1 sell), PT ~$351; aftermarket/engine demand plus a defense tailwind.
positions.risks: Rich valuation near the high; cyclical aero exposure; broad-tape beta.
positions.driver: Best-in-class aero-engine franchise with Strong Buy support and momentum into the high.

positions.name: ConocoPhillips
positions.catalyst: Energy is the top S&P sector YTD (+22%); WTI elevated on Hormuz/Iran supply risk; COP 52w $86-$136 leaves upside room.
positions.risks: Oil reversal on de-escalation/inventory builds; CPI-week macro; no company catalyst.
positions.driver: Low-cost E&P levered to the oil bid as energy leads the rotation.

positions.name: Chevron
positions.catalyst: Hormuz/Iran oil-supply risk plus energy-sector leadership; $20B FY26 buyback; CVX 52w $138-$215.
positions.risks: Oil-price/de-escalation risk; downstream margin swings; macro.
positions.driver: Integrated major with shareholder-return support riding the energy bid.

positions.name: Goldman Sachs
positions.catalyst: Dow record on rotation into financials/value; Wall Street banks landing the year's biggest deals; GS at/near records.
positions.risks: Rate/curve sensitivity into CPI/PPI; capital-markets cyclicality; coarse sizing at a high share price.
positions.driver: Bulge-bracket leader on the bank-rotation theme with a re-accelerating deal pipeline.

positions.name: JPMorgan Chase
positions.catalyst: Bank-rotation bid (Dow record); resilient NII and capital returns; JPM near highs as value/financials lead.
positions.risks: CPI/PPI rate risk; credit-cycle concerns; broad-financial beta.
positions.driver: Highest-quality money-center bank levered to the financials rotation.

positions.name: Morgan Stanley
positions.catalyst: Wealth-management plus IB rebound; bank rotation alongside GS on record Wall Street deal flow.
positions.driver: Wealth/IB franchise riding the same capital-markets reacceleration and rotation bid.
